title: Proximity-CLIP
protocol: Maintain parental cell line without APEX2 expression.
Culture a cell line expressing V5-tagged APEX2 localized to the cytoplasm.
Culture a cell line expressing V5-tagged APEX2 localized to the compartment of interest.
Ensure at least 3 distinct cell lines are prepared for each experiment.
Maintain all cell lines at similar passage and confluency levels.
Split cells into plates or dishes ensuring sufficient number for preparative protein and RNA assays, Western blot, and immunofluorescence controls.
Prepare standard medium for cell culture \((DMEM, 10\% FBS, 1:1000 PenStrep)\).
Supplement pre-selection medium with 100 µg/ml Zeocin and 15 µg/ml Blasticidin.
Defrost cells in standard media.
Expand each control and experimental strain in its own selective medium: parental T-Rex cells in pre-selection medium, APEX2-expressing cells in post-selection medium.
Collect and count cells.
Split collected cells into standard media according to the specified guidelines.
Add 4-thiouridine \(4SU) stock to cell culture media at a final concentration of 100 μM, using an intermediate x10 dilution in standard media to 50 mM.
Add Doxycycline (DOX) to all plates to a final concentration of 2 μg/ml, using an intermediate x100 dilution for 24-well plates to 200 μg/ml.
Prepare a 500 mM stock solution of BP by dissolving it in DMSO.
Sonicate the 500 mM BP stock if necessary.
Aliquot the 500 mM BP stock into 50-μl portions and store at -80°C.
Dissolve sodium azide in Millipore water to prepare a 1M stock solution.
Aliquot the 1M sodium azide stock and store at -20°C or below.
Bring standard media to 37 °C.
Warm PBS to room temperature.
Have liquid N₂ available at the bench.
Weigh required amounts of Sodium ascorbate and Trolox.
Dilute the required amount of 500 mM BP stock 50 times in standard medium to prepare a 10 mM BP solution.
Add 50 μl of the 10 mM BP per 1 ml of media to achieve a final concentration of 500 μM BP.
Prewarm the medium to 37 °C before adding BP to facilitate dissolution.
Sonicate the BP solution if necessary to ensure complete dissolution.
Prepare 1500 µl fresh X100 stock of 100 mM H₂O₂ in DPBS immediately before use, by diluting 30% (wt/wt) H₂O₂ reagent into Dulbecco’s PBS.
Dissolve pre-weighed Sodium ascorbate powder in Millipore water to prepare a fresh 1M solution immediately before making the quencher solution.
Sonicate well after dissolving Trolox powder in DMSO to prepare a fresh 500 mM stock immediately before use.
Make 500 ml of fresh quencher solution containing 10 mM sodium ascorbate, 5 mM Trolox, and 10 mM sodium azide in DPBS immediately before quenching the biotinylation reaction.
Prepare 4% PFA in PBS.
Dilute the 100 mM H₂O₂ directly to the cell media by a factor of 1:100 to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM.
Briefly agitate the solution.
Incubate the cells at room temperature for 1 min.
Aspirate the labeling solution quickly.
Wash all cells three times in large volumes of quencher solution.
Introduce the quencher solution gently and carefully to avoid cell loss.
Pour off the liquid rather than aspirating by vacuum if necessary.
Add 750 μl quenching solution after the last wash.
Remove plate caps and crosslink the plates with 0.4 J/cm² of 312 - 365 nm UV light in a UV Crosslinker.
Fix the 24 wells cells with 4% PFA in PBS for 20 minutes at RT during UV crosslinking.
Remove the 6 / 15 cm plates from the UV instrument.
Place the plates on ice.
Collect cells with quenching solution in pre-chilled tubes.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 300g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Snap freeze cells in liquid N2.
Store frozen cell pellets at -80 °C.
Wash PFA-fixed cells three times with 1 ml PBS.
Fix-perm cells in pre-chilled -20 °C methanol.
Incubate fixed-permed cells for 20 minutes at -20 °C.
Block cells with 5% BSA in PBS for 60 minutes at 4 °C.
Centrifuge the diluted primary antibody for 10 minutes at maximum speed to remove aggregates.
Incubate cells overnight at 4 °C with primary antibody.
Wash cells three times for 5 minutes with PBS the next day.
Incubate cells with secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature.
Centrifuge the diluted secondary antibody for 10 minutes at maximum speed to remove aggregates.
Wash cells three times for 5 minutes with PBS.
Mount cells over 9 μl vectashield with dapi.
Prepare 4 ml RIPA lysis buffer with 1× protease inhibitor cocktail, 1 mM PMSF, 10 mM sodium azide, 10 mM sodium ascorbate, and 5 mM Trolox.
Lyse cell pellets by gentle pipetting in 300 μl of the RIPA lysis buffer.
Leave the sample on ice for 2 min after resuspension.
Centrifuge the sample at 15,000g for 10 min at 4 °C to clarify the extract.
Transfer the supernatant to fresh pre-chilled tubes and keep them on ice.
Quantify protein concentration in each clarified whole-cell lysate using the Pierce 660-nm assay.
Dilute clarified whole-cell lysate if necessary, so that concentrations fall within the linear range of the assay.
Prepare triplicate samples for each condition.
Take 15 μl aliquots of streptavidin magnetic beads and wash twice with 1 ml of RIPA lysis buffer.
Incubate 150 μg of each whole-cell extract with 15 μl of streptavidin magnetic beads at 4 °C overnight on a rotator, adding 150 μl of RIPA buffer to facilitate rotation.
Save the remaining whole-cell lysate for gel and western blot analysis.
Pellet the beads using a magnetic rack and collect the supernatant.
Save the supernatant on ice for subsequent analysis.
Wash each bead sample with RIPA lysis buffer twice.
Wash each bead sample once with 1 M KCl.
Wash each bead sample once with 0.1 M Na₂CO₃.
Wash each bead sample once with 2 M urea in 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0.
Wash each bead sample twice with RIPA lysis buffer.
Heat each sample in 60 μl of 3× protein loading buffer supplemented with 2 mM biotin and 20 mM DTT for 10 min at 97 °C while vortexing.
Let the samples cool, spin down, and pellet the beads using a magnetic rack.
Quickly collect the eluate into new tubes.
Load 10 μl of the eluate for western blot analysis.
Prepare and boil whole-cell lysate in 1× protein loading buffer.
Cool the samples on ice and spin them briefly to bring down condensation.
Run the whole-cell lysate, streptavidin enrichment eluate, and flow-through samples on a 4-20% wt/vol gradient SDS gel.
Perform a streptavidin-HRP western.
Check that there is no biotinylated material left in the flow-through.
Prepare 4 ml RIPA lysis buffer with 1× protease inhibitor cocktail, 1 mM PMSF, 10 mM sodium azide, 10 mM sodium ascorbate, and 5 mM Trolox.
Lysate cell pellets from 15 cm plates by gentle pipetting in 800 μl RIPA lysis buffer.
Leave the lysed samples on ice for 2 min.
Centrifuge the lysates at 15,000g for 10 min at 4 °C to clarify.
Take 30 μl of cell extracts for total RNA extraction.
Use approximately 80 μl of cell extracts for protein content analysis.
Wash 60 μl aliquots of streptavidin magnetic beads twice with RIPA lysis buffer.
Incubate the washed beads with ~500 μl of whole-cell lysates and 60 μl of streptavidin magnetic beads at room temperature on a rotator for 1 h.
Pellet the beads using a magnetic rack.
Collect the flow-through (FT) from the pelleted beads for subsequent analysis.
Wash each bead sample with 1 ml of RIPA lysis buffer.
Wash each bead sample with 1 ml of 1 M KCl solution.
Wash each bead sample with 1 ml of 0.1 M Na₂CO₃ solution.
Wash each bead sample with 1 ml of 2 M urea in 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0.
Wash each bead sample with 1 ml of RNase treatment buffer (NP40 lysis buffer).
Split the beads into three aliquots: 300 μl for Mass Spec, 200 μl for RNA seq, and 500 μl for RNase T1 treatment.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μl of RNase T1 buffer.
Add RNase T1 to a final concentration of 1 U/μl.
Incubate the mixture at 22 °C for 15 min.
Cool the reaction on ice for 5 min.
Wash beads twice with RNase T1 buffer.
Wash beads once with dephosphorylation buffer (NEB CutSmart x1).
Prepare a dephosphorylation mix of 30 μl of 10x cutSmart, 255 μl ddw, and 15 μl CIP.
Resuspend the beads in 60 μl of dephosphorylation mix.
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 min with shaking.
Wash beads twice with 1 ml of dephosphorylation buffer.
Wash beads twice with 1 ml of PNK buffer without DTT.
Resuspend the beads in 60 μl of HOT radioactive reaction mix.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C with shaking.
Add non-radioactive ATP to a final concentration of 100 μM and incubate for additional 5 minutes at 37°C.
Place tubes on magnet; keep 50 μl of the radioactive waste.
Wash beads five times with 1 ml of PNK buffer without DTT.
Measure radioactivity of the beads after washing is complete.
Freeze the beads in a radioactive-approved -20°C freezer.
Defrost the beads in 30 μl of 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate and 20 mM DTT.
Shake for 1 hour at increasing temperatures: 25°C (30 min), 37°C (20 min), 56°C (10 min).
Add 6 μl of 200 mM Iodoacetamide in 25 mM Ammonium bicarbonate.
Shake for 1 hour at 25 °C.
Spin down the mixture.
Place tubes on magnet and collect fluid.
Wash beads three times with 200 μl of 1 mM DTT in 25 mM Ammonium bicarbonate.
Dissolve 20 μg of Trypsin in 1 ml of 25 mM Ammonium bicarbonate.
To the beads tube, add 98 μl of 25 mM Ammonium bicarbonate and 2 μl of Trypsin (40 ng).
Shake overnight at 37 °C with cap to avoid condensation.
Spin down the mixture.
Place tubes on magnet.
Transfer the eluate to fresh tubes.
Boil remaining beads in 30 μl of 3× protein loading buffer supplemented with 2 mM biotin and 20 mM DTT for 10 minutes at 97 °C while vortexing.
Spin down the mixture.
Place on a magnetic rack to pellet the beads.
Collect eluate into new tubes and store.
Bring non-labelled intact beads out of freezer.
Perform cold proteolysis in parallel with hot proteolysis.
Add 1.2 mg/ml proteinase K in 200 μl of 1x Proteinase K buffer to the sample.
Incubate the sample at 50 °C under vigorous shaking for 30 min.
Add 0.75 mg/ml proteinase K in 150 μl of 1x Proteinase K buffer to the existing volume, making a final volume of 500 μl.
Incubate the sample at 50 °C under vigorous shaking for 30 min.
Repeat step with another addition of 0.75 mg/ml proteinase K in 150 μl of 1x Proteinase K buffer to make a final volume of 500 μl.
Incubate the sample at 50 °C under vigorous shaking for 30 min.
Place tubes on magnet and transfer supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Measure radioactivity of beads and discard them.
Add 30 μl of 5 M NaCl and 300 μl acidic phenol-chloroform (pH 4.5) to the supernatant.
Mix by vortexing and incubate on bench for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12000g for 10 min.
Transfer the top of the aqueous phase (300 μl) to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 300 μl of chloroform to the mixture.
Mix by vortexing.
Centrifuge at 12000g for 7 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Precipitate the RNA by adding 1 µl of glycol-Blue (10 mg/ml).
Mix well.
Add 3 volumes of ethanol and incubate at -20°C for at least 1 hour.
Centrifuge the sample at >12000g for 20 minutes.
Remove all ethanol traces.
Let pellets dry for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Dissolve the pellet in 20 μl of water.
To the supernatant, add 30 μl of 5 M NaCl and 300 μl acidic phenol-chloroform (pH 4.5).
Mix by vortexing.
Incubate on the bench for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12000g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the top of the aqueous phase (300 μl) to a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 300 μl of chloroform and mix by vortexing.
Centrifuge at 12000g for 7 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Precipitate the RNA by adding 1 µl of glycol-Blue (10 mg/ml).
Mix well.
Add 3 volumes of ethanol and incubate at -20°C for at least 1 hour.
Spin at 4 °C for 15 minutes at maximum speed.
Wash pellets twice with 75% EtOH.
Air dry for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 20 µl of DEPC ddw.
To the 30 μl samples of cell extracts, add 370 µl ddw DEPC and immediately after 400 µl biophenol.
Vortex.
Incubate 15 min on bench.
Spin 10 min at maximum speed.
Transfer 200 µl of aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add the same volume of ddH₂O-saturated chloroform to the new tube.
Vortex and spin for 8 minutes at maximum speed.
Transfer 100 µl of the aqueous phase to another new tube.
Add 7 µl of 3 M NaAc to the transferred aqueous phase.
Add 400 µl of cold 100% EtOH to the mixture.
Vortex and incubate at -80 °C for at least 3 hours.
Spin at 4 °C for 15 minutes at maximum speed.
Wash pellets twice with 75% EtOH.
Air dry the pellets for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellets in 20 µl of DEPC ddH₂O.
Perform rRNA depletion only on total RNA samples according to the NEBNext® Ultra™ RNA Library Prep Kit manual.
Perform RNA fragmentation for 10 minutes.
Determine the size of RBP-protected RNA fragment by denaturing polyacrylamide electrophoresis as described in reference.
Image the gel after overnight radiography.
Excise fragments representing 20 - 40 nt lengths from the gel.
Excise fragments representing 41 to ~80 nt lengths from the gel.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at maximum speed in a gel breaker tube.
Add 350 µl of 0.3 M NaCl to the tube.
Shake for 1 hour at 60 °C.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 5000g through a filter tube.
Add 1 μl of Glyco-Blue and 1200 μl of EtOH to the solution.
Vortex and incubate greater than 3 hours at -80 °C.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at maximum speed.
Air dry the pellet.
Resuspend in 8.7 µl ddH₂O.
Prepare 3’ ligation mix as specified in the protocol.
To each 8.7 μl RNA add 8.3 μl of the prepared ligation mix and 2 μl of adenylated 3’ adapter.
Incubate the mixture for 1 min at 90 °C, then place on ice.
Add 1 μl T4 Rnl2(1-249)K227Q (1μg/μl) to each tube, mix gently and incubate overnight on ice.
To each tube add 20 μl of denaturing PAA gel loading solution.
Incubate the mixture for 1 min at 90 °C and load it onto a 15% denaturing PAA gel.
Excise ligated footprints from just below the size marker to the top of detected RNA on the gel.
Extract the RNA from the excised gel by centrifuging in a gel breaker tube for 1 minute at maximum speed.
Add 350 μl of 0.3 M NaCl to the extract and shake for 1 hour at 60 °C.
Centrifuge the mixture for 1 min at 5000g through a filter tube.
Add 1 μl of Glyco-Blue plus 1200 μl of EtOH, vortex, and incubate for more than 3 hours at -80 °C.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at maximum speed, air dry the sample, and resuspend it in 9 μl ddw.
Incubate the RNA at 90°C for 1 minute.
Place on ice after denaturation.
Add 2 μl of Rnl1 (1 mg/ml, ABI) and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C.
To 20 μl of RNA, add 20 μl of denaturing PAA gel loading solution.
Incubate the mixture at 90°C for 1 minute.
Load on a 12% denaturing PAA gel as described in section 5.
Image the gel after overnight radiography and excise the ligated RNA.
Centrifuge the gel breaker tube at maximum speed for 1 minute.
Add 350 μl of 0.3 M NaCl to the mixture.
Shake the solution for 1 hour at 60°C.
Centrifuge the mixture for 1 minute at 5000g in a filter tube.
Add 1 μl of Glyco-Blue and 1200 μl of EtOH, vortex thoroughly.
Incubate the mixture greater than 3 hours at -80°C.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at maximum speed.
Air dry the precipitate.
Resuspend in 4.6 μl of double distilled water (ddw).
Denature the RNA at 90°C for 1 minute.
Chill to 50°C and add 9.7 μl of reverse transcription mix.
Add 0.7 μl of Superscript III to the mixture.
Mix the solution thoroughly.
Incubate the reaction for 1 hour at 50°C.
Dilute each cDNA by adding 85 μl of DEPC ddw to reach a volume of 100 μl.
Set up a 60 μl PCR reaction as specified in the protocol.
Split the mixture into 6 tubes and run with the following cycles: 2 min at 94 °C, followed by 45 sec at 94 °C, 85 sec at 50 °C, and 60 sec at 72 °C. Repeat for 19 cycles.
Remove a tube from the PCR cycler to ice after 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 19 cycles.
Load the entire content of each tube on a 2.5% agarose gel and run for 1 hour to select the optimal number of cycles.
Set up an identical PCR mixture at a volume of 300 μl and run the PCR for the selected optimal number of cycles, splitting into 3 tubes with 100 μl each.
Concentrate the PCR product by using a ZYMO PCR purification kit to reach 70 μl.

Size-select 30 μl of the library using PipenPrep to deplete residual primers and adapter-adapter products based on expected sizes: linker-linker - 126 bp, 20-40 nt footprint libraries - 146-166 bp, 40-80 nt footprint libraries - 166-196 bp.
